family.description: Matched-algorithm gap of gf2's adopted production LDPC route against AFF3CT [Cassagne2019], under the comparator-family contract of dev/active/55c3e433-aff3ct-ldpc-gaps/plan.md. The baseline arm gf2-batch-tuned is the gf2-coding LdpcBatchDecoder of default construction under the committed coding envelope gf2-3ee00fcf-20261104t064432z-4012544, whose selectors include the QC route cases of qc-go-rule, with NR BG1 Z=384 structure attached after an exact parity-check comparison outside timing; the QC route therefore runs at NR w1-b1 and p12-b8, and every other cell keeps its existing route. The candidate arm aff3ct-flooding-nms-f32 is AFF3CT's flooding f32 normalized min-sum decoder at the pin of c077a88b, one clone per pinned worker, with its syndrome check at depth one. The cells, arms, comparator-gap objective, ratio direction and margins are those of FI-3's family 1362381c-ldpc-aff3ct-integration (@/issue/1358d6ab): the speedup is gf2 time divided by AFF3CT time, so an evaluator pass means AFF3CT holds a material advantage and a value below one means gf2 is faster. The AList graphs, recorded LLRs, f32 flooding NMS factor 0.75, cap 50, syndrome stopping, timed prefix and steady-state decode boundary are those of 55c3e433-integrated-adoption. Each worker owns its decoder before timing; conversion, dispatch and information-window extraction are included. Each arm reports its per-frame iteration counts after timing, direct for gf2 and replay-derived for AFF3CT. The search budget allows two twelve-pair pilots; pilot 2 (55c3e433-adopted-vs-aff3ct-pilot-2) supplies the resolution read by experiments/aff3ct-ldpc-gaps/freeze-confirmation.py for one 24-pair confirmation of the six cells. Pilot 1 (55c3e433-adopted-vs-aff3ct-pilot, receipt SHA-256 1065c2cc8c486b90a0957f242d51ccfaa407f9b389a925e14419629430f6ccdb) has an accepted, non-qualifying receipt with no findings; its freeze is refused because equivalence_margin 1.1 does not exceed 1 + resolution 0.48. On host fraktaali, the recorded load averages at window start are 4.15 7.06 7.37; the nr-bg1-z384-p12-b8 pair ratios span 0.106–0.322, consistent with host interference. Pilot 1 and its freeze refusal remain recorded; the freeze uses only pilot 2 as resolution evidence. History: FI-3's pre-adoption route has its own ledger, whose confirmation reservation its AFF3CT candidate holds. This family's ledger contains pilot 1's exploratory reservation and no confirmatory reservation, so prior_trials is empty; FI-3's results and pilot 1 remain descriptive history that no estimate here reuses. The family publishes the gap and selects nothing, so it declares no holdout.

effect.rationale: The family publishes the matched comparator gap with AFF3CT [Cassagne2019] and adopts nothing, so it declares no worthwhile speedup.
effect.equivalence_rationale: Within ten percent at matched settings, a receiver choosing between gf2's production route and AFF3CT [Cassagne2019] gains too little throughput to repay integrating and maintaining a second decoder dependency, so the family reads the arms as equivalent. Fixed before this pilot; the canonical freezer stops when pilot resolution reaches it and never widens it from results.
effect.material_gap_rationale: A steady-state gap of a quarter of a receiver's decode throughput at matched settings outweighs the integration and maintenance cost of a second decoder dependency, so it changes which decoder a receiver deploys and needs attribution; it lies outside the equivalence margin. Fixed before this pilot; the canonical freezer stops when pilot resolution reaches it and never widens it from results.

complexity_budget.maintenance_rationale: The family selects nothing and adds no production code.
